svg.title: What is inside Lilystack
svg.desc: The sprint: think (office-hours, spec), plan (plan-ceo-review, plan-eng-review, plan-design-review, plan-devex-review, autoplan), build (build), check (review, verify, qa, test-audit), ship (ship, feedback). Anytime: investigate, retro, context-audit, write-skill, prose, frontend-design, security-audit, compound, second-opinion. Safety hooks: careful, secrets, secure, test-first, freeze, unfreeze, guard. Mods: focus, verify-gate, outbound-ledger, status. Lily tools: bin/lily, lily-check, lily-lint, lily-sweep. Also inside: agents/lens, output-styles/ste, evals/, .claude-plugin/.
svg.text: Use the sprint from left to right, or call any skill alone.
Looks back at a git window
Writes a skill the diet way
Call one, and its hook is active until the session ends. You start these, not Claude.
Optional, and separate from the plugin. You add each mod by itself. No mod uses the network.
The owner's own builds. They act on Lilypad.
Newer Claude Code parts: a plugin agent, an output style, an eval suite and a marketplace.
A lens that can only read
Every skill is Markdown. Every hook is a bash script. The tables below give each call.
